theorems.name: Submission.p04_eq_zero_of_prime_avoiding_annihilators
theorems.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V], (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ ¬ p ∣ m ∧ ∀ v : V, m • v = 0) → ∀ v : V, v = 0
theorems.natural_summary: For each element, the hypothesis at prime 2 supplies a positive annihilator. Choose the least such annihilator n. Euclidean division and minimality show that n divides every annihilator. If n ≠ 1, a prime divisor p of n contradicts the supplied p-avoiding annihilator. Thus n = 1 and the element is zero. No finiteness assumption is used.
